name: What is cabinet refacing and how does it differ from cabinet replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is cabinet refacing and how does it differ from cabinet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet refacing involves keeping your existing cabinet boxes and replacing or covering the visible external components, such as doors, drawer fronts, and hardware, with new materials. This typically includes applying a new veneer to the cabinet frames. In contrast, cabinet replacement entails removing and installing entirely new cabinet boxes, doors, and drawers. Refacing can be a practical tradeoff if your current cabinet boxes are structurally sound, offering a refreshed aesthetic without the full scope of a demolition and installation of new cabinetry. AKN Design Group can help assess the condition of your existing cabinetry to determine the most suitable approach for your renovation goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet refacing updates existing cabinet boxes with new doors, drawer fronts, and veneers, while replacement involves installing entirely new cabinets. Refacing is a practical tradeoff when existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound.
